::: {.content-visible when-format="docx"}
# Book_06 — Eliminating NTLM at the SQL Layer
:::

::: {.callout-note}
SQL Server is one of the most common sources of NTLM traffic in a federal environment, and the reasons are more varied than most DBA teams expect. This book traces ADR-068's three phases — assess, block-where-safe, eliminate — as they apply to the SQL Server workload, against the program's hard 2027-04-01 network-level block. (ADR-068)
:::
